verdict.rationale: BVNK documents its own rule-based automation: payment rules created via POST /payment/v1/rules link a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address, so incoming fiat is automatically on-ramped to crypto and sent on without manual action. This is a single, narrow, payment-specific automation rather than a general facility for setting up background automations. Webhooks are notification building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general-purpose configurable automations beyond fiat-to-crypto rules, scheduled or recurring jobs, documentation of rule management and monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically on-ramp to crypto and send to blockchain addresses.
To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the `POST /payment/v1/rules` request
